title: KOGNAI-STATUS-CLI — daily operator dashboard showing all system states
description: Build scripts/status.ts — a CLI dashboard the operator runs daily. Shows: TikTok gate progress (posts/30, days remaining, pace), Achiri alpha countdown (days to Apr 25, readiness score), Godman launch countdown (days to Apr 14, publish checklist), env vars status, action items. Single file, <150 lines.
